decisions.question: Confirm beef (牛肉) as its own topping id, family meat.
options: beef = own id, meat (canonicalizer GENUINELY_NEW_REGISTRY 牛肉→beef, Phase 0B.1)
decisions.authority: GENUINELY_NEW_REGISTRY['牛肉']='beef'; every related id (steak, ground-beef) is meat, so the steak / ground-beef relation cannot change the family

decisions.question: Condiments: spread sauce, or topping (then family spice)? Decide category first.
decisions.authority: TAXONOMY_FLAGS sauce_or_condiment (mustard, yuzu-kosho, balsamic, chutney, 溶かしバター); false_friend_not_meat (梅肉); PR #255 NEEDS_REVIEW
decisions.newFamilyPressure: A 調味料 family would be new (PR #293 NF-2). If neither option is acceptable → STOP.

decisions.question: green-onion (青ねぎ / 万能ねぎ): vegetable or spice (薬味)?
options: spice (スパイス・薬味, as a garnish)
decisions.authority: PR #255 NEEDS_REVIEW; related runtime boundary: garlic (herb) is also OD-TAX-7

decisions.question: Creamy dairy: cheese (no hint family) or topping? sour-cream / condensed-milk may also be a spread sauce.
decisions.authority: PR #255 NEEDS_REVIEW (cheese vs dairy)
decisions.newFamilyPressure: 乳製品 is not one of the 7 (PR #255 §9: 'do not use'). A topping outcome must pick `other` explicitly, not by default.

decisions.question: Prepared / composite foods: accept as ingredient ids (family of the main ingredient), re-canonicalize, or exclude?
options: accept: chicken-tikka / peking-duck / hot-dog / liver-pate = meat, baked-beans = vegetable
decisions.authority: TAXONOMY_FLAGS prepared_dish_composite (chicken-tikka, hot-dog, peking-duck); PR #255 NEEDS_REVIEW
